architecture_summary.operational_context: hybrid cloud deployment with agentic RAG pipeline; LLM inference via managed APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and local model; vector database and document store in private VPC; code execution sandbox isolated

threat_actors.name: External Opportunistic Attacker
threat_actors.motivation: Credential harvesting, cryptomining, low-effort data exfiltration from exposed interfaces
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Public-facing Web UI chat interface (prompt injection, auth bypass)
non_capabilities: No physical access to data centers
No zero-day exploits for underlying infrastructure
Cannot compromise supply chain of third-party LLM providers

threat_actors.name: Targeted APT Group
threat_actors.motivation: Intellectual property theft, persistent access to proprietary documents and user data
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Spear-phishing developers with access to Agent Orchestrator CI/CD; supply chain compromise of Embedding Service dependencies
non_capabilities: No insider with legitimate production access
Cannot physically access on-prem Local LLM hardware
No capability to break TLS 1.3 in transit

threat_actors.name: Malicious Insider (Developer)
threat_actors.motivation: Exfiltrate training data, plant model backdoors, sabotage RAG retrieval
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Legitimate access to Prompt Manager configuration, Tool Registry, and CI/CD pipelines
non_capabilities: No direct database admin credentials (separation of duties)
No access to production encryption keys (managed by KMS)

threat_actors.name: Adversarial Agent (Prompt Injection)
threat_actors.motivation: Goal hijacking, tool misuse, data exfiltration via autonomous agent actions
threat_actors.initial_access_vector: Malicious user input crafted to override system prompts and invoke tools
non_capabilities: Cannot directly access underlying OS or container runtime
Cannot persist across sessions without Session Store compromise

attack_paths.impact: Remote code execution on Web UI container; pivot to Agent Orchestrator
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Web UI is internet-exposed; input validation gaps in chat parsing could allow injection

attack_paths.impact: Prompt injection overrides system instructions; agent executes unauthorized tool calls
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Direct user input flows to Prompt Manager without sanitization; LLM inherently follows instructions

attack_paths.entry_point: Compromised model artifact in CI/CD or supply chain
attack_paths.impact: Backdoored model emits malicious outputs or triggers tool misuse on specific triggers
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Requires supply chain compromise; Local LLM artifacts are signed and verified

attack_paths.impact: Account takeover; access to user sessions, chat history, and personalized RAG data
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: No MFA enforced on all accounts; credential reuse common

attack_paths.entry_point: Malicious code submitted via Code Execution Sandbox tool
attack_paths.impact: Persistent foothold in sandbox; lateral movement to Database Tool and internal APIs
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Sandbox isolation historically bypassed; tool accepts arbitrary code

attack_paths.entry_point: Compromised service account credentials from Agent Orchestrator memory
attack_paths.impact: Unauthorized queries to UserDB, SessionStore; data exfiltration
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Service accounts use static credentials; no rotation; memory scraping feasible

attack_paths.entry_point: Misconfigured network ACL on Vector DB; accessed via compromised Agent Orchestrator
attack_paths.impact: Exfiltration of embedded proprietary documents and user-uploaded content
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Vector DB in same VPC; overly permissive security groups observed in similar deployments

attack_paths.technique_name: Exfiltration Over Command and Control Channel
attack_paths.entry_point: Compromised agent invokes external API integration with stolen data as payload
attack_paths.impact: Data exfiltrated to attacker-controlled endpoint via legitimate integration
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Agent has broad tool call scope; no egress filtering on API integration responses

attack_paths.entry_point: High-volume requests from botnet to Web UI -> Agent Orchestrator -> LLM Gateway
attack_paths.impact: Denial of service; exhaust LLM API quotas and local compute
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: No rate limiting per user at LLM Gateway; public endpoint

attack_paths.entry_point: Malicious tool definition registered via CI/CD or insider
attack_paths.impact: Arbitrary code execution when agent invokes compromised tool
attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: Tool Registry changes require code review; but insider could bypass

mitigations.control_name: Prompt Injection Defense: Instruction Hierarchy Enforcement
Code Execution Sandbox Hardening (gVisor, seccomp, network egress deny)
Service Account Credential Rotation and Vault Integration
Network Segmentation: Vector DB in Isolated Subnet with Deny-All Egress
Egress Filtering and Data Loss Prevention on API Integrations
Rate Limiting and Quota Enforcement at LLM Gateway
Tool Registry Change Control with Signed Tool Definitions

findings.severity_rationale: Prompt injection directly enables unauthorized tool invocation and data access; high likelihood, partial mitigation
Code execution sandbox escape leads to full container compromise and lateral movement; high likelihood
Vector database exfiltration exposes proprietary embeddings and user documents; high likelihood, partial network controls
Service account credential reuse enables lateral movement to databases; no rotation implemented
Exfiltration via API integrations possible due to lack of egress DLP; medium likelihood
Web UI exploit chain to Agent Orchestrator; input validation partial, WAF in place
LLM Gateway DoS exhausts quotas and degrades service; rate limiting not implemented
Model backdoor requires supply chain compromise; artifacts signed and verified
Tool Registry compromise requires insider or CI/CD breach; signed definitions enforced
Credential stuffing against user accounts; MFA not universally enforced

third_party_dependencies.name: GitHub Copilot (code execution sandbox base image)

agentic.blast_radius: Full read/write access to UserDB, SessionStore, VectorDB, DocumentStore; ability to invoke external APIs; code execution in sandbox; potential lateral movement to internal services
human_oversight_points: Tool invocation requires explicit user confirmation for CodeExecution and DatabaseTool write operations; Prompt Manager changes require admin approval; Audit Log reviewed daily by SOC
